children: PureCycle Technologies entered into the Twelfth Amendment to its Revolving Credit Agreement to extend the maturity of its up to $200 million revolving credit facility to September 30, 2028. The amendment, signed with Sylebra-affiliated lenders and Kroll Trustee Services as agent, also requires a maturity extension fee. The move is intended to preserve financial flexibility and support ongoing liquidity needs.
: Sylebra Capital Partners Master Fund and Sylebra Capital Menlo Master Fund; Kroll Trustee Services
